menu.name: March Wine Pairing
menu.description: Course One: Mushroom Marsala Baked Brie - Mini Baked Brie Wheel topped with Mushrooms, Marsala Sauce, & Pine Nuts, Served with Mini Naan, Paired with A Telleira Godello Ribeiro '24. Course Two: Mediterranean Snapper - Grilled Red Snapper Tossed in Lemon Juice & Olive Oil, Topped with Sautéed Onion & Swiss Chard, Cherry Tomatoes, Black Olives, Feta Cheese, & Parsley, Served Over Lemon Orzo, Paired with Montaña Blanco '20. Course Three: Lamb Meatballs - Smoked Bacon, Roasted Tomato, & Gouda Polenta, Tzatziki Sauce, Paired with Montaña Rioja Crianza '21. Course Four: Lemon Blueberry Cheesecake - Lemon & Blueberries infused in a New York Style Cheesecake, Blueberry Compote, Graham Cracker Crust, & Whipped Cream, Paired with Mont Marcal Cava Brut Reserva '23
